messages.subject: Status of .parallel wrt windows?
parts:
Hi,

I'm curious about the status of .parallel=TRUE for windows + vanilla R.  I regularly use this in linux via the DoMC handler.  I've heard about the "new package parallel incorporating (slightly revised) copies of packages multicore and snow" (http://cran.r-project.org/web/views/HighPerformanceComputing.html), and don't quite understand how all this fits together.  Searches of list+google turn up scattered questions from 2010-2011, but nothing recently.  Does the new parallel package change anything for non-POSIX systems?

Thanks,
Christian
